model_identity.method: Compile exact SHA-verified archived XML/assets with explicit already-built plugin. No current scene generation/plugin build/forward/collision/integration.

identity.replay_plugin_binary_scope: Explicit supplied existing replay binary anchor; original run did not report a plugin binary SHA. Original plugin SOURCE SHA is recorded independently.

calibration_event.scope: Actual head/tool frame before jaw opening; no selected thread phase

identity.frame_scope: Frozen exact release calibration from original event; saved post-state hole frames held fixed separately across each full 65-clock sweep. No future moving-hole prediction. Actual event calibration originated retained original geometry t−dt at phase boundary; saved post-state seeds are labeled.
identity.scope: Finite-joint kinematic reachability local IK of planned frozen OPEN orbit. No collision/contact/force solve/dynamics, trajectory feasibility/actuation proof, source edits, interpolation, object writes, capture or physics success claim.

immediate_endpoint_ik.scope: Immediate geometry-only full remaining-goal IK from actual saved failed six-joint state; local bounded solution only

conservative_head_pad_axis_projections.scope: Conservative pad-axis projection; no separating axis here is inconclusive, not a collision/penetration measurement.
